preview_command: Reconstruct the retained workspace, then run python3 -m http.server 4405 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory app/dist. The retained app source and lockfile also support npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4405 after installing declared dependencies. Use ?theme=light&lang=en or ?theme=dark&lang=zh.
capture_conditions: Chrome headless shell 143.0.7499.4 / Playwright 1.57.0, recorded CJK font, DPR 1; 1440x900, 1280x600, 390x844, light/en and dark/zh, controlled synthetic streaming/failure and emulated touch. Ordered frame inspection; no natural-time playback.
